corrected_claim_statement: The empirical data strictly establishes that Hermes experiential memory successfully induced behavioral adaptation and eliminated exploratory probes (from 1 probe down to 0). It does NOT establish lower wall-clock latency, as prompt expansion and local model inference overhead resulted in a 7.53s execution time compared to 2.75s for the ungrounded control.
